description:
When orcas swim past, great white sharks leave their hunting grounds within minutes, and at California's Farallon Islands they stayed away for up to a year. Doug follows the great white from the Farallones to Gansbaai and False Bay in South Africa, where the most feared shark in the sea started disappearing after orcas arrived.

Where should we send Doug next? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe and watch Doug's death counter keep climbing.
